judge_note: The Amma/Appa gold and FD pairing is a specific, warm, familiar scene. It ends on a personal question, 'You?'.

slides.headline: Amma saved in gold. Appa in FDs. You?
slides.subhead: Both still work. What will your kids say you added beside them?

points.title: Myth: Only for experts
points.text: Fact: Many salaried families and business owners use them for regular saving.

points.title: Myth: Replaces gold, FDs
points.text: Fact: It's a different option. Keep gold, FDs or both. You're adding choice.

points.title: Myth: Money gets locked
points.text: Fact: Open-ended funds can usually be redeemed on business days. ELSS has a 3-year lock-in.
